create_standard_pdf_pipeline: create a StandardPdfPipeline instance with PdfPipelineOptions to convert PDF documents using OCR, layout, and table models
run_pdf_conversion: run the StandardPdfPipeline to convert a PDF file into a structured document with extracted text, tables, and images
download_models_hf: download ML models required by StandardPdfPipeline from HuggingFace Hub to a local directory
get_default_options: get default PdfPipelineOptions for StandardPdfPipeline with OCR, table structure, and enrichment enabled by default
check_backend_supported: check whether a given document backend is a supported PDF backend for StandardPdfPipeline
